answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 33077 Country: India Title: irresponsible father Question: I am a house wife. I am mother of 3 children 2 daughters and 1 son. Our entire property is in me and my husband’s name. My husband is controlling the entire business. He is not a responsible father towards his children; he is ruining his business from last 7 years and not taking the responsibility of his children’s marriage. He is wasting his money on other people for his fame. All reconciliation from last 7 years has been failed. Without any other option I have taken a decision to let my son takeover the entire business and take the responsibility of my daughter. My question is, taking over the business under such circumstance for protecting the family is allowed for a son or not? Please clarify. Thank you. Answer ID: 33077 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1480/900/H=1432) If your husband hands over the business happily and wholeheartedly and your son takes it into his control then there is no harm. If you have chosen any other system "to take decision" then write it clearly and submit the question again. What does your husband say about not taking the responsibility of children's marriage? Had your question been clear we would have written its reply. It is not clear what you mean by “they spend on others for fame”. Where does he spend? Write it clearly as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
